Paragraph: "From whom your fear is spurted, oh, gentle Sugreeva, that elder brother of yours, who is an evildoer and the one with harmful intent... that Vali is not here. Therefore I perceive no fear from him..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Re-triggering of past trauma caused by an abusive sibling.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuma validates Sugreeva's past reason for fear, but affirms its present irrelevance.
Outcome/Resolution: He separates past trauma from present safety.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Bheda-Jnana (Discriminating between past trauma memory and present reality)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Understanding that past source of bondage cannot touch the soul in its current sanctuary.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Trauma processing: helping the individual distinguish between historical threat sources and present safety.
